observations.behavior: Documentation change: clarifies that list-contract-products is the product catalog, not a per-contract endpoint.
observations.code_quote: Note: Campfire has no public OpenAPI (docs.campfire.ai/openapi.json 404s) but ships a complete llms.txt index of ~330 documented operations. list-contract-products is the product catalog listing (GET /rr/api/v1/product) rather than a per-contract endpoint, so it covers products on its own; list-product-bundles is still a separate gap. list-contract-subscriptions is only reachable per contract (GET /rr/api/v1/contracts/{contract_id}/subscriptions), so contract_subscriptions fans out over the contracts table.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the API endpoint behavior for Campfire, potentially aiding warehouse ingestion. No implementation or test changes are supplied.
